answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the basalt of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Work waits on the copper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the lantern of the next round.
